text:
Marcus - Events: Heads-up — co-hosted live lab with GreenCloud on Tue 9:00 CET (8:00 UK). Need final speaker list, hardware routing, and fallback plan. Ping @Lina @Jae for marketplace + slides.
Lina Gomez: I have 3 speakers confirmed: Mira (GreenCloud PM), Tom (GreenCloud Eng), and Anya (SI lead). Can we reserve a 25-min slot for the hands-on? :white_check_mark:
Jae Park: Marketplace/legal needs a product blurb + logo by Monday. I'll draft the AWS listing copy and link the purchase/how-to afterwards.
Evan (Partners): Shipping note — GreenCloud is shipping a demo rack and 2 small boxes of swag. Customs doc: CN23 + commercial invoice. ETA to AMS warehouse Wed. Tracker: TRACK-ECU-558.
Marcus - Events: Cool. Logistics: one rack goes on-stage for live demo, one rack stays in staging for failover. We should have a 'live->hosted' fallback if the VPC demo fails.
Lina Gomez: For the VPC demo we'll need ephemeral keys + an approved firewall rule. Sarah, can infra pre-create a VPN/client cert and ephemeral tokens for the SI? Also confirm KMS access (GreenCloud uses their KMS for keys).
Sarah - Infra Ops: I can create ephemeral tokens: TTL 2h. Will add firewall rule to allow GreenCloud IPs (send me the CIDR). Also confirm KMS cross-account policy is in place.
Jae Park: Webinar page needs the speaker bios + 1-sentence takeaway for each demo. I'll collect from Mira/Tom/Anya and share a Google doc.
Evan (Partners): Swag plan: we'll do co-branded tees + stickers. Suggest split pallets: AMS (on-site), DUB (remote attendees). I'll upload customs forms to the shared Drive.
partners-bot: Event created: 'GreenCloud x Redwood - Live Lab (Hybrid)'. Reminder scheduled 2 days before event.
Marcus - Events: Run order draft (short):
```
08:50 - mic / AV check
09:00 - Marcus intro (5m)
09:05 - Demo A: GreenCloud VPC private deploy (15m)
09:20 - Demo B: SI integration (10m)
09:30 - Q&A + CTA (20m)
Fallback: swap to hosted-redwood/model-lite if VPC not reachable
```
Lina Gomez: Also allocate 5 minutes for a quick watchers' lab link + ephemeral creds drop. We should finalize the lab host URL and TTL.
Marcus - Events: Action owners: Marcus do runbook & AV; Lina collect bios/slides; Jae marketplace + webinar page; Evan swag & shipping; Sarah infra tokens & firewall. Can everyone confirm by EOD Friday? :rocket:
Anya (SI lead): I'll send the demo checklist and CIDRs by EOD today.
Marcus - Events: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the runbook and post final links here. :thumbsup:
